source: Written for VPM to the upstream package's API and behavior. Emotion's tests are retained in scripts/emotion-conformance/upstream (repository commit 49229553967b6050c92d9602eb577bdc48167e91, tag @emotion/styled@11.14.1).
changes: Written for VPM in plain JavaScript: createStyled (styles from templates and interpolations, the as prop, prop forwarding, labels and targets, withComponent, styling styled components) and the element shorthands.

The theme context is read on every render: the original read it only when the theme prop was null, so a component whose theme prop came and went changed the order of its hooks (React warns in development).

On vemotion-is-prop-valid (so current HTML attributes such as command and commandFor reach DOM elements), vemotion-serialize, vemotion-utils and vemotion-use-insertion-effect-with-fallbacks; vemotion-react is a peer, as @emotion/react is.
No macro entry, so no run-time dependency on @emotion/babel-plugin or @babel/runtime: 4 direct dependencies instead of 6.
Declarations on React's React.JSX namespace, checked with React 18.3 and 19 types.

verification.upstreamSuite: Emotion's 293 tests pass with this package and the other eleven VPM Emotion packages in place of every original, in development and production builds and with React 16 and React 18.
verification.regression: hook-order.cjs renders a styled component whose theme prop comes and goes with React 16.14: React reports a change in the order of hooks for the original and nothing for VPM.
verification.declarations: types.cjs compiles a TSX application (shorthands with props, shouldForwardProp, styled components, withComponent, an augmented Theme, and two expected errors) with React 18.3 and 19 types under TypeScript 7.1, 5.8 and 5.9.
